title: Rockstar releases the Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer and says the game arrives November 19
dek: Rockstar has a launch trailer out, a new song from Justice in it and a release date in its post.
what: On October 15, Rockstar Games posted the Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer. Its post says the trailer features the debut of "Flower in a Hurricane" by Justice, with Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, and that the game arrives November 19. Rockstar's own trailer page, dated October 15, carries the same song credit. I did not find the release date on that page, so November 19 rests on Rockstar's post.
A post from GameRoll_ says the game will be eligible for The Game Awards in December, with a cut-off of November 20. That is one account's post and I did not find the awards organiser's notice.
why: A trailer with a date and a new song by a well known act reaches players, music fans and film accounts at once.

sources.label: Rockstar Games: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
